body.args_str: bash -c 'set -eu; if ! command -v sshd >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssh-server; fi; mkdir -p /run/sshd /root/.ssh; chmod 700 /root/.ssh; printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' KEY > /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null; (sleep 60m; until python3 -c '"'"'import os, urllib.request as u; u.urlopen(u.Request('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'https://console.vast.ai/api/v0/instances/'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' + os.environ['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'CONTAINER_ID'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'] + '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'/'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', method='"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'DELETE'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', data=b'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'{}'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', headers={'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'Content-Type'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"': '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'application/json'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'Authorization'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"': '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'Bearer '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' + os.environ['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'CONTAINER_API_KEY'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']}), timeout=30)'"'"'; do sleep 60; done) >/dev/null 2>&1 & exec /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -o PermitRootLogin=prohibit-password -o PasswordAuthentication=no'
body.label: LABEL
